long_run_op_margin.why: The company is commodity-exposed, and the 2008-2025 margin history is volatile with a median well below the recent 30-40% levels. I fade to about 27%, which keeps part of the above-median gap, per the cyclical base rate.

op_margin.why: GAAP margin in 2026 is depressed by a large derivative loss and one-time costs. 2027 onward assumes a recovery as derivative losses fade and synergies are captured, offset by lower prices and service-cost inflation. Margins then drift down gradually.

quotes: George Green as Senior Vice President – Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary

risks.basis: Loss and balance-sheet figures are stated in the filings; the mechanism is inferred from the risk-factor text.
risks.claim: Commodity derivative positions produced a $684 million net derivative loss in Q3 2026, and current derivative liabilities were 552 (table in millions) at Sep. 30, 2026. Hedges can lose value when prices rise, which cuts reported earnings and cash.
quotes: We recorded a net derivative loss of $684 million and a net derivative gain of $272 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and June 30, 2026, respectively.
Our commodity derivative contract activities may result in financial losses or may limit the prices we receive for oil, gas, and NGL sales.

risks.basis: Stated in the cited items; the absence of impairment is inferred from the line items shown.
risks.claim: A fall in oil prices could force property impairments. Realized oil price already dropped sequentially from $96.85 to $85.76 per Bbl.
quotes: In addition, sustained declines in oil, gas, and NGL prices could result in impairments of certain oil and gas properties.

risks.basis: Stated in the earnings release; the revenue effect is inferred.
risks.claim: Full-year oil production guidance was lowered by 1% to 220-222 MBbl/d, partly because of Uinta Basin takeaway constraints that are expected to continue into early 2027. A production shortfall could reduce revenue and free cash flow.
quotes: We are modestly lowering full-year oil guidance to 220-222 MBbl/d due to transitory factors, while reiterating our full-year total production outlook.
Included in our oil volume guidance is a continued impact from takeaway constraints in the Uinta Basin.

risks.basis: Debt figures are stated; the exposure is inferred from the risk factor. The counter is stated in the 10-Q MD&A.
risks.claim: The company carries heavy debt: noncurrent Senior Notes of 6,614 (table in millions) and net debt of $6.0 billion, with Q3 interest expense of (116) (table in millions). This leaves it exposed to price declines and covenant limits.
quotes: The amount of our debt may limit our ability to obtain financing for acquisitions, make us more vulnerable to adverse economic conditions, and make it more difficult for us to make payments on our debt.

risks.basis: Risk stated in the 10-K; the counter is stated in the 10-Q and the earnings release.
risks.claim: The Civitas merger may not deliver its expected benefits, and the 10-K flags integration risk. Evidence from Q3 2026 points toward integration largely succeeding.
quotes: We may be unable to successfully integrate Civitas’ business into our business or achieve the anticipated benefits of the Merger, which may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.

risks.basis: The cost figures are stated; attributing them to inflation is inferred.
risks.claim: Cost inflation could raise operating and capital costs. Lease operating expense was $7.02 per Boe in Q3 2026, against $5.67 a year earlier.
quotes: Importantly, despite service-cost inflation, we now expect 2026 capital of approximately $2.75 billion, the midpoint of our prior range, supported by synergy capture and ongoing efficiency gains.
We continue to monitor these conditions and their potential effects on our operating costs, capital expenditures, and development economics.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release.
risks.claim: Regional gas basis differentials hurt realized gas prices, which were $0.17 per Mcf in Q2 2026 and $2.48 in Q3 2026. A renewed widening could cut gas revenue.
quotes: Regional basis differentials in the Permian Basin and the DJ Basin have adversely impacted our realized gas prices, particularly during the first half of 2026.

unresolved_questions.basis: Loss and settlement amounts are stated in the cited items. The split of the remainder and the hedge terms are not in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much of the $684 million third-quarter net derivative loss is unrealized mark-to-market rather than cash settlement, and what hedged volumes and prices remain? Settlement losses were $207 million, and the packet omits the hedge book.
quotes: We recorded a net derivative loss of $684 million and a net derivative gain of $272 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and June 30, 2026, respectively.

unresolved_questions.basis: The expectation is stated in the earnings release. The cause, the timing of the remedy and the volume at stake are not given in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will the Uinta Basin takeaway constraints that lowered oil guidance actually be resolved in early 2027, as management expects? The evidence gives no detail on the cause or the fix.
quotes: We expect the factors leading to our lower oil production outlook to be resolved in early 2027.

unresolved_questions.basis: Net debt figures and the return percentage are stated. A leverage target is not stated anywhere in the packet, so this is an inference from the omission.
unresolved_questions.claim: What net debt or leverage level does the company regard as sufficient, and when would a larger share of free cash flow go to stockholders? Net debt fell to $6.0 billion from $7.4 billion, but the evidence gives no target.
quotes: Reduced net debt1 to $6.0 billion, down from $7.4 billion at March 31, 2026.

unresolved_questions.basis: Prices and management's description are stated in the cited items. Whether the improvement lasts is not answerable from them.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will Permian and DJ Basin gas basis differentials stay narrow? Realized gas price was $0.17 per Mcf in the second quarter and $2.48 per Mcf in the third, and management says regional pricing constraints continue to influence realizations.
quotes: Differentials narrowed through the late second and third quarters as regional demand strengthened.

unresolved_questions.basis: Both gain figures and the proceeds are stated. The accounting effect of the final settlement is not stated.
unresolved_questions.claim: Does the final post-closing settlement on the South Texas Divestiture change the gain recorded? The nine-month gain on divestiture is 260, against an estimated $262 million in the second quarter, and the final settlement came after quarter-end.
quotes: an estimated gain of $262 million related to the South Texas Divestiture

unresolved_questions.basis: The cash tax guidance is stated in the release. The 10-K risk factor describes a risk only, and the amount of usable attributes is not in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much of the acquired Civitas net operating losses and other tax attributes can actually be used, and what drives cash taxes of $100-$120 million for 2026?
quotes: Full-year 2026 cash tax guidance is updated to approximately $100-$120 million.

unresolved_questions.basis: The pre-merger figures are stated. The post-merger reserves are absent from the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: What are the combined company's proved reserves and reserve life after the Civitas merger? The only reserve figure in the packet is the pre-merger year-end 2025 total of 673.0 MMBOE.
quotes: Estimated net proved reserves decreased slightly to 673.0 MMBOE as of December 31, 2025 from 678.3 MMBOE as of December 31, 2024.
